title: Whole-window SWAP5-MODFLOW6 acceptance and retry

authority.ownership: predictor/corrector remains inside the internal SWAP5-MODFLOW coupling service below iMOD Coupler

capability_goal: Define and qualify one atomic whole-window acceptance boundary spanning the retained SWAP candidate, finalized MODFLOW timestep state, and groundwater exchange ledger, with fail-closed reconstruction for a smaller-window retry after an abandoned prepared solve.
required_invariants: SWAP retains ownership of trial, retry and commit semantics.
MODFLOW prepared-solve nonlinear iteration remains the F-GC38/F-GC39 backend lifecycle.
No participant is published as accepted unless all three publication participants are ready for the same window and provenance.
A failed publication preflight must leave SWAP committed state, MODFLOW accepted timestep state and committed exchange ledger unchanged.
An abandoned prepared solve is never reused as accepted MODFLOW state.
Retry reconstructs a fresh MODFLOW window from the last accepted timestep state and reruns SWAP from the same accepted origin over the smaller requested window.
Exchange ledger publication is bound to the exact accepted coupling lineage/window and cannot be committed independently.
iMOD Coupler does not acquire predictor/corrector or participant commit ownership.
qualification_questions: What exact MODFLOW6/XMI operation constitutes irreversible timestep publication after finalize_solve?
Can all participant readiness be proven before the first irreversible publication operation?
What accepted MODFLOW state must be retained or reconstructed before prepare_time_step so an abandoned prepared solve can be retried at a smaller window?
What ordering or compensation contract is required if MODFLOW timestep publication cannot be rolled back after SWAP or ledger publication failure?
How is one coupling lineage/window identity carried across retained SWAP candidate, MODFLOW timestep and prepared ledger token?
existing_reusable_surfaces: F-GC39 retained final SWAP candidate and finalized prepared solve contract
reconcile_verdict: F-GC41 is a real new decision surface. F-GC39 explicitly stops before finalize_time_step and irreversible SWAP publication; current canonical has no F-GC41 authority. Start with MODFLOW timestep publication/reconstruction semantics before production implementation.
next_permitted_action: Obtain exact-head CI evidence. If F-GC41 tests pass, extend qualification to a live MODFLOW6 timestep finalization fixture and an independent verifier before admission. Do not merge while exact-head evidence is absent.

modflow_semantics.prepare_time_step: opens/materializes a MODFLOW timestep before prepare_solve; a live timestep is not reused for retry
modflow_semantics.prepare_solve: establishes nonlinear solve with accepted previous-time XOLD
modflow_semantics.solve: updates X while XOLD remains accepted previous-time origin
modflow_semantics.finalize_solve: closes converged solve; F-GC39 crosses this only after coupled convergence
modflow_semantics.finalize_time_step: finishes the MODFLOW timestep; F-GC39 deliberately stops before this boundary
modflow_semantics.abort_primitive: No admitted XMI abort_solve/rollback primitive. Abandoned prepared solve is invalidated, not reused.

scientific_architectural_decision: Last accepted MODFLOW timestep, not abandoned X/XOLD working state, is the retry origin.
Smaller-window retry requires a fresh MODFLOW timestep lifecycle reconstructed from the last accepted model state with the smaller dt.
All reversible SWAP and ledger preparation must complete before MODFLOW finalize_time_step.
F-GC41 must not claim generic distributed atomicity across failures after an irreversible external publication call.
Use fail-before-publication: ordinary validation and physics rejection must be exhausted before the publication sequence.
Crash durability/restart during irreversible publication is a separate concern, not rollback.
required_coordinator_order: stage and prepare exact-window ledger token
non-mutating preflight of MODFLOW timestep-finalization readiness
preflight ledger token plus exact lineage/window identity
cross publication point only after all preflights pass
commit retained SWAP candidate using preflighted identity
advance accepted coupling origin only after publication completes
retry_contract: before publication, abort/discard prepared SWAP and ledger state on failure
reconstruct MODFLOW from last accepted timestep state
prepare fresh smaller timestep and prepared solve
re-enter F-GC39 from immutable accepted SWAP origin
do not reuse candidate revision, ledger generation, XMI pointer views or prepared-solve session identity
remaining_blocker: Production implementation must expose or prove non-mutating readiness/preflight seams for retained SWAP candidate and MODFLOW timestep finalization before irreversible call ordering is admitted.
qualification_surface: preflight failures publish nothing and request retry
success publishes MODFLOW then SWAP then ledger exactly once
post-publication failure is not mislabeled rollback-safe
retry identities are fresh while accepted SWAP origin is retained
MODFLOW readiness check is non-mutating and timestep finalization is one-shot
